title: Botswana, Côte d’Ivoire Forge Historic Mining and Energy Partnership
desc: Two African countries seal their first agreement on mining and energy cooperation, deepening plans for exploration, skills exchange and industrial growth in Africa

title: 60,000 cross into Spanish territory of Ceuta, at least 34 die, after border breach
desc: Some 60,000 migrants have entered Spain’s Ceuta from Morocco in the past 24 hours, Ceuta’s president says. At least 34 have died in the process.

title: Lake Saif-ul-Malook road closed as heavy rains trigger landslides, flooding across Upper Hazara
desc: Authorities have closed the Naran–Lake Saif-ul-Malook Road to all types of traffic until further orders after heavy monsoon rains lashed the upper parts of Hazara Division, triggering landslides, flash flooding, and road blockages at several locations.

title: CTV Scale Malaysia Launch
desc: CTV Scale Malaysia has officially launched in partnership with MeVe Tech, bringing a transparent Connected TV advertising platform to Malaysian brands and agencies.

title: Fullscope-seq maps transcript isoforms with spatial single-cell resolution
desc: Researchers have developed Fullscope-seq, a long-read spatial transcriptomics platform that maps alternative transcript isoforms within intact tissues at single-cell resolution – opening new possibilities for target identification and precision biomarker discovery.

title: Infantino's top adviser quit and released a scathing statement about the World Cup investment row
desc: Carlos Cordeiro described the plans as a “bad deal for football” and said Fifa “already has access to extraordinary financial resources”.

title: Audit: Only 2.5 per cent of teachers come from marginalised communities
desc: Audit underscores persistent underrepresentation of marginalised communities and PWDs in Kenya's teaching workforce

title: Yung Filly court case: UK rapper found not guilty of raping Australian fan
desc: Yung Filly, the British rapper and media personality accused of raping a fan after an Australian show, has been acquitted of some charges.

title: West Ham: Amanda Staveley and Mehrdad Ghodoussi's PCP Capital Partners make offer for stake in Championship club
desc: PCP Capital Partners - run by former Newcastle owners Amanda Staveley and her husband Mehrdad Ghodoussi - have made an offer to buy a 25.1 per cent stake in West Ham; the share currently belongs to the family of the late David Gold
